title: rubus foliosus var. illepidus
intro: Rubus foliosus var. illepidus, commonly known as the thorny bramble, is a variant of the Rubus foliosus plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to provide health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rubus foliosus var. illepidus include antiseptic, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
